record.paper_title: Open problems in billiards and quantitative symplectic geometry
record.original_question: Let (N,g) be an orientable closed hyperbolic surface and let D*N be its unit disk cotangent bundle with canonical symplectic form d lambda. Is the Hofer-Zehnder capacity c_HZ(D*N,d lambda) finite?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(N,g)$ be a closed orientable hyperbolic surface, i.e. a closed orientable smooth surface of genus at least two equipped with a Riemannian metric of constant sectional curvature $-1$. Using the metric, identify the cotangent bundle $T^*N$ with the tangent bundle, and let
$$D^*N \;=\; \{(q,p)\in T^*N : |p|_g \le 1\}$$
be the unit disk cotangent bundle, equipped with the canonical symplectic form $\omega = d\lambda$, where $\lambda$ is the Liouville one-form on $T^*N$.

Recall the Hofer–Zehnder capacity of a (possibly non-compact) symplectic manifold $(M,\omega)$: a smooth function $H\colon M\to\mathbb{R}$ is called HZ-admissible if
(i) $H$ is compactly supported in the interior of $M$,
(ii) there exist open subsets $U,V\subset M$ with $U\neq\varnothing$ such that $H\equiv\min H$ on $U$ and $H\equiv\max H$ on $M\setminus V$,
(iii) $0\le H\le\max H$, and
(iv) every non-constant periodic orbit of the Hamiltonian vector field $X_H$ defined by $\iota_{X_H}\omega = -dH$ has period strictly greater than $1$.
Then
$$c_{HZ}(M,\omega) \;=\; \sup\{\max H : H \text{ is HZ-admissible}\} \;\in\; [0,\infty].$$

Question. Is $c_{HZ}(D^*N,\, d\lambda) < \infty$?
artifact.status_search_result: Finiteness of the Hofer–Zehnder capacity of unit disk cotangent bundles is known under various topological hypotheses (e.g. nonzero Hurewicz map $\pi_2(N)\to H_2(N;\mathbb{Z})$, or $N$ rationally inessential), via work of Irie, Albers–Frauenfelder–Oancea, and others using symplectic homology with local coefficients. Closed orientable hyperbolic surfaces are aspherical with $\pi_2=0$ and are essential, so none of the known criteria apply. Recent literature (including 2023–2024 papers by Bimmermann and collaborators on disc cotangent bundles over surfaces) explicitly notes that finiteness of $c_{HZ}(D^*N)$ for closed orientable surfaces of genus $\ge 2$ remains an open question, while finiteness is known for non-orientable surfaces.

status_evidence.title: Hofer–Zehnder capacity of unit disk cotangent bundles and the loop product (Irie)
status_evidence.snippet: Finiteness of the Hofer-Zehnder capacity of unit disk cotangent bundles of closed Riemannian manifolds is proved under some simple topological assumptions.
status_evidence.claim: Establishes the principal known sufficient conditions for finiteness, which do not apply to closed hyperbolic surfaces.

status_evidence.title: Local systems on the free loop space and finiteness of the Hofer-Zehnder capacity
status_evidence.snippet: Vanishing of symplectic homology with local coefficients implies finiteness of the π1-sensitive Hofer-Zehnder capacity of D*M, e.g. when the Hurewicz map π2(M)→H2(M;Z) is nonzero.
status_evidence.claim: The criteria known to imply finiteness are not satisfied by closed orientable hyperbolic surfaces.

status_evidence.title: Hofer–Zehnder capacity of disc tangent bundles of projective spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work computing Hofer-Zehnder capacities for tangent bundles; notes that finiteness for orientable closed surfaces of genus ≥ 2 remains open while non-orientable cases are settled.
status_evidence.claim: Indicates that the question of finiteness for closed orientable hyperbolic surfaces is still open.
